name: Ловля фігури (3)
description: Mobility is key for chess pieces, allowing them to execute multiple offensive and defensive tasks. If a piece has limited mobility, it is at risk of being trapped. By attacking and taking away all escape squares, you can confine such pieces and gain decisive material advantage.

examples.text: Black has positioned their pieces extremely poorly and loses material after a clever pawn move by White.
After the surprising 1...f6!, the white knight is suddenly trapped.
